en.headline: Fire Services links Shek Kwu Chau incinerator blaze to smoking or welding
en.dek: Investigators ruled out electrical faults, arson and spontaneous combustion after the October 26 No. 3 alarm at I.PARK1; the Environment Protection Department ordered tighter controls.
body: The Fire Services Department said it had completed its investigation into the No. 3 alarm fire that broke out on 26 October at the Integrated Waste Management Facilities Phase 1 (I.PARK1) on an artificial island off Shek Kwu Chau.

The department found the fire started on an upper level of the third incineration module of the incinerator building. It ruled out electrical faults, arson and spontaneous combustion of chemical substances, and said the cause was likely related to welding works or smoking.

The Environmental Protection Department said it had received the report and instructed the contractor to immediately review and strengthen fire-risk measures, with particular attention to hot works including welding and a further tightening of the site-wide smoking ban.

zh.headline: 消防指石鼓洲焚化廠火警或涉燒焊或吸煙
zh.dek: 調查排除電力故障、縱火及化學自燃，環保署已責成承建商加強熱工序管理及收緊禁煙措施。
body: 消防處表示已完成上月26日石鼓洲旁人工島綜合廢物管理設施第一期（I.PARK1）三級火的調查，包括現場蒐證及向相關人士錄取口供。
調查顯示起火位置位於焚化爐大樓第三焚化模組高層。處方排除電力故障、蓄意縱火及化學物質自燃，認為原因可能與燒焊工程或吸煙有關，並已將報告轉交環保署。
環保署指已收到報告，並責成承建商即時檢視及加強消除火警風險的措施，特別針對包括燒焊在內的熱工序，以及進一步收緊地盤全面禁煙的範疇。
